home.fleetSubtitle: Two configurations, every Eicher. Open body with fitted tarpaulin sheet for short hauls, closed container for long hauls and delicate loads.

open.title: Eicher Open Body · Tarpaulin Sheet
points: Open-body Eicher fitted with a tarpaulin sheet as standard.
Sheet-on cover protects furniture from rain, dust and sun on short hauls.
Quick to load — best for same-day and short-distance moves.

closed.title: Eicher Closed Container
points: Fully enclosed container body — dust, rain and theft resistant.
Default for long hauls and delicate loads (electronics, antiques, glass).
Lockable rear door; cargo strapped and padded for the run.

about.title: About Tuty Packers
about.subtitle: A Thoothukudi business built on referrals, repeat customers and Eicher trucks.
about.story: We started small — a single Eicher, a couple of drivers, and a list of customers who'd call back. Word travelled faster than the trucks did. Today we still run a tight Eicher-only fleet, and the list of phone numbers that ring the moment a move is planned keeps growing.
about.fleetBody: Eicher means one thing to us: predictability. Same chassis, same parts, same trained drivers. When you book us, you don't roll the dice on a stranger's truck — you get one we own and maintain.
about.valuesBody: Upfront quotes. Honest ETAs. Real people on the phone at 2am when a long-haul needs to roll. We don't subcontract — our drivers are our drivers.
